**1. Calculate the total number of seats:**
$$5 \text{ rows} \times 8 \text{ seats per row} = 40 \text{ seats}$$

**2. Calculate the cost of the seats without the discount:**
$$40 \text{ seats} \times \$30 \text{ per seat} = \$1,200$$

**3. Determine the discount:**
The discount applies to "each group of 10 seats."
$$40 \text{ seats} / 10 = 4 \text{ groups of seats}$$

The cost of one group of 10 seats is:
$$10 \text{ seats} \times \$30 = \$300$$

The discount for one group (10%) is:
$$\$300 \times 0.10 = \$30$$

Since there are 4 groups, the total discount is:
$$4 \text{ groups} \times \$30 = \$120$$

**4. Calculate the final price:**
$$\$1,200 \text{ (original price)} - \$120 \text{ (total discount)} = \$1,080$$

The school will pay **$1,080** for the new seats.
